text:
Harper J.: Quick plan 15-min micro-launch: demo the pricing calculator + run an inline vs gated experiment. tight and measurable.
Noah R.: what are the top KPIs?
Harper J.: primary = booked demos from higher-fit accounts. secondary = calc starts and email captures.
Kim L.: experiment matrix: traffic split 60/40 (60% inline open calc, 40% gated advanced estimator). test FAQ copy variants in parallel.
Zara P.: gating fields: work email, company size bucket, optional monthly token estimate. keep it short so completion rate stays high.
ops-bot: suggestion: if domain in account_list OR company_size_bucket in [1000+,500-999] => tag:priority_sdr
Noah R.: landing headline draft: "Estimate inference cost in 60s" subhead: "Compare Metered vs Committed and get a recommendation."
Kim L.: FAQ microcopy idea (variant short): Committed -> "Predictable monthly price", "Reserved capacity", "SLA & priority support"; Metered -> "Pay per token", "Autoscale bursts", "Cost-saving hints".
Zara P.: FAQ variant long: include sample numbers and a one-line latency expectation for each tier. keep bullets to 2 lines max.
Harper J.: webinar flow: 3m why pricing matters, 7m live calc with 3 real examples, 3m quick Q&A + CTA to try calc or book demo.
Noah R.: benchmark line for the slide: "Optimized batching + model choice can reduce per-token spend ~30% while keeping 95th-pct latency within SLO for most production mixes." Zara will refine with exact numbers.
Zara P.: will tighten and add example table before deck freeze.
Kim L.: tracking: UTM=pricing-dualpath-3055551234; variants via ?variant=inline|gated. embed snippet for devs (iframe):
```
<iframe src="https://embed.redwood.ai/pricing-calc?utm=pricing-dualpath-3055551234&variant=gated" width="100%" height="560"></iframe>
```
Harper J.: routing: ops-bot create rule tag:webinar_inbound + tag:priority_sdr for high-fit. ops-bot?
ops-bot: event created "pricing-dualpath-3055551234". rule "tag:webinar_inbound" applied to registrants. rule "priority_sdr" will apply for domain matches or company_size>500.
Noah R.: SDR handoff format: CSV with email, company, company_size_bucket, token_estimate, utm_variant, lead_tags, free_text_use_case. include timestamp.
Kim L.: timeline: promo Friday, live Tuesday. copy QA Monday morning in #marketing-summaries. can someone pair with me for proofing?
Zara P.: I'll join Monday AM. Harper, can you confirm success thresholds?
Harper J.: targets: booked demos >=7% of attendees, calc starts +12% vs baseline, gated lead quality +20% (win-rate proxy).
Noah R.: noted. final ask: small confirmation email copy (one line + CTA). Kim, can you draft and post in #marketing-summaries by EOD?
Kim L.: on it. Harper: thanks team :sparkles:
